history.summary: DUPLICATE FLAG: this CSV row (Yogamaya Kali Temple) refers to the same temple as seq 2486 (id maa-jogomaya-baba-lokenath-temple-jalpaiguri) — the famous Sri Sri Jogomaya Kalibari on Temple Street, Nutan Para, Jalpaiguri town, which also houses a Shiva lingam and a Baba Lokenath shrine. 'Yogamaya' is a spelling variant of 'Jogomaya/Jogmaya', and a separate directory listing for 'Yogamaya Kali Temple' gives the same Temple St / Nutan Para / Teli Para address. One district article claims a 'Yogamaya Kali Temple' distinct from the town's Jogomaya exists — not verified, treat as unproven. Recommend merge with seq 2486.

name: Yogamaya Kali Temple
town_description: Jalpaiguri is a district headquarters town in north West Bengal on the banks of the Teesta river, gateway to the Dooars region. The temple sits at Temple Street, Nutan Para/Teli Para, in the busy market area of the town.

travel.railway: Jalpaiguri Road and Jalpaiguri stations are both a few km away; New Jalpaiguri Junction (~40 km) is the major hub
travel.road: On Temple Street, Nutan Para, Jalpaiguri town — reachable by local toto/auto; reviewers report parking problems on the busy street

visitor_information.best_time: October–March; Durga Puja and Kali Puja seasons are the biggest but most crowded
visitor_information.opening_hours: One directory lists 8:00 AM–8:00 PM daily; seq 2486 reports 5:00 AM–9:00 PM per reviewers with a possible 1:30–4:00 PM closure — not officially verified (verify)
